import bpy, os
def force_black(mat_name):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.get(mat_name)
    if mat:
        mat.use_nodes = True
        bsdf = next((n for n in mat.node_tree.nodes if n.type == 'BSDF_PRINCIPLED'), None)
        if bsdf:
            for l in list(bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].links): mat.node_tree.links.remove(l)
            bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (0, 0, 0, 1)
            bsdf.inputs['Emission Color'].default_value = (0, 0, 0, 1)
            bsdf.inputs['Specular IOR Level'].default_value = 0
            vibe_log(f'FORCED_BLACK: {mat_name}')
force_black('EXTO_Mat_Head_Eyelash')
force_black('EXTO_Mat_Head_Details')
force_black('EXTO_Mat_Gloves_Main')
force_black('EXTO_Mat_Warmers_Main')
bpy.context.view_layer.depsgraph.update()
vibe_log('ACTIVE_SESSION_HEALED_v3')
